_about: Armadeus (261089, darkness_dragon): Rooma reborn. Translated from the game's Japanese. Global names/terms: Armadeus, Rooma, Couette, Rustamov, Rams, Schult, Anbach, Capella, Maiko Warren, Arum, Arly, Adjudicus, Eric, Marly, Challua, Light, Stella, Alk, Curse Crystals, Fiends, the Purgers, Dracostream, the Dragon of Darkness. Own: Koma (コーマ), Gram (グラム), Deus Ex Arma (skill, as in units.json).
profile: An ancient dragon who defied his fate and fell to a curse. For ages he was twisted by rage and hatred. But he met a girl, walked within dreams-- and the dragon took flight into a new life.
titleCondition: Level Armadeus to 100 and obtain his Amity Scroll

speech.home/bokuwarumadakedo: I'm Rooma, but I'm also Armadeus. That's why I want to know. What I felt... as the Dragon of Darkness.
speech.home/a_anone_koma: U-um, Koma? You don't have to spoil me, you know...? I know I'm still a kid...! B-but it's embarrassing...!!
speech.home/hontteiiyone: Books are nice, aren't they? Music, too. It's like my world gets painted in bright colors... ...Yeah. I think it's really wonderful.
speech.home/kiokunokeishowa: I think I'll keep inheriting memories from here on. There were sad things too... ...but I don't want to lose the feelings that were passed on to me.
speech.home/konomae: I met Couette's parents the other day, and they looked at me and said I was "beautiful"...! People are often scared of the power of darkness, so it made me really happy...!
speech.home/bokumohayaku: I want to hurry up and grow big like the other dragons. It can't be helped, but my power isn't complete yet either... Though I do like being able to talk with my friends at eye level.
speech.ally/join: My name is Armadeus. People often call me the Dragon of Darkness... ...but my friends call me Rooma.
speech.ally/evolution: I want to protect humans. But not because I'm Armadeus. It's because I want to protect everyone's feelings...! --That's why I'll fight. Come on, let's go!!

1.title: The New Dragon of Darkness
1.summary: Waiting for his rebirth within the Dracostream, Armadeus answers Couette's call and is reborn in Starview Village. Overjoyed at his reunion with Couette, Armadeus hears her talking in her sleep after she tires herself out, and dreams of the days of adventure ahead.

lines.4: Hmm. So you can remember things from before your rebirth?
lines.6: It's all in pieces now. But the feelings that matter--
lines.10: Looks like this is where we part ways.
lines.11: That's too bad. Well, if we meet somewhere, let's meet again! The Holy Dragon and the Dragon of Darkness teaming up sounds fun, right?
lines.14: Rustamov, huh... What an interesting kid.
lines.18: ......Yeah. I hear you. I hear you.
lines.20: As if I could ever forget.
lines.32: Couette...! Thank you for calling me...!!
lines.46: ...Everyone too. I'm happy to see you again.
lines.54: You're welcome. ...You remember us too, huh?
lines.59: Most of it is missing. But the time I was Rooma, I remember clearly...!
lines.62: But... somehow everyone seems a little smaller...?
lines.67: You're the one who got bigger. Aren't you about the size of a small pony already?
lines.72: So that is the new Rooma's form.
lines.77: Um, should I call you Armadeus instead of Rooma...?
lines.86: ...No. I want you to call me Rooma.
lines.100: Mmhehe! Rooma is Couette's friend, and his name is Rooma!
lines.106: Nice to meet you. I'm... Armadeus. I was just reborn a little while ago--
lines.117: Looks like Couette's worn out. Are you okay, Rooma?
lines.121: I'm fine. If anything, I'm overflowing with power. ...So this is Armadeus's power.
lines.124: ...Um, that girl earlier. She's a fiend... right?
lines.129: So it is on your mind? The arts the fiends used seemed deeply connected to you...
lines.136: I... Armadeus once gave power to people who had been driven away by higher beings.
lines.139: So they could live even in barren lands. --His own blood and flesh.
lines.143: ...And those were the ancestors of the fiends...?
lines.147: ...Because of that... so many battles were born...
lines.162: Th-thank you. Um... Rams. Schult. Anbach. ...Right?
lines.172: S-sorry. I'm still missing a lot of Armadeus's memories...
lines.177: You don't need to be bound by things like that. Didn't I say? Do as you please.
lines.180: You only need to fly your own sky.
lines.190: Well, I don't think you need to decide that in a hurry either.
lines.193: You can take your time and look for it here. Couette would be happy too.
lines.199: Yes. Welcome back to Starview Village, Rooma.
lines.215: Couette. You'll catch a cold if you sleep here. Let's go to bed, okay?
lines.219: ...Mmmn~... Tonight, I'm going to Rooma's dream...
lines.224: Yeah. In dreams, and in all kinds of worlds, together--
lines.227: Let's go on lots of adventures from now on.

2.title: Feelings Bound to Darkness
2.summary: To learn his lost past, Armadeus regains his memories using Curse Crystals, but he is tormented to learn that his past left behind nothing but hatred and curses. Saved by the words of Adjudicus and others living in the present, Armadeus looks forward, resolving to live on together with the feelings of who he once was.

lines.5: --I see. So you were pulled up directly by that girl.
lines.9: Yeah. Thanks to her, I got to see everyone right away. And they all welcomed me so warmly...
lines.25: While I was getting beaten up by that violent woman, you were all lovey-dovey and cozy.
lines.28: No fair. Can you teach me that memory inheritance trick too?
lines.32: S-sure, I don't mind... But right now, I'm missing Armadeus's memories--
lines.39: Actually, we've already got the Curse Crystals ready. The fiends searched for them in preparation for your rebirth.
lines.44: Of course, you don't have to use them if you don't want to. It's just something to have ready for when you want your memories.
lines.48: N-no! It's just what I wanted...!
lines.51: What I was like before... with Capella and the others. What Armadeus was searching for.
lines.57: ...Will you come with me too, Couette? I'm still... a little scared.
lines.71: U-um. Rustamov, how about you come too?
lines.75: Haha, oh, fine. If you're that scared, the Holy Dragon himself will come along!
lines.81: So this is... where this era's fiends...
lines.90: ...They're abandoning this place. Everyone's planning to move to a new world.
lines.93: Let's go. The Curse Crystals are ready over there.
lines.97: Apparently this is all of them that have been found so far.
lines.105: ...Tell me, Armadeus. What dreams did I have--!
lines.123: I-I'm... fine... I was just... a little surprised...
lines.129: I wanted to help humans, so I gave of myself. In return, I received their wishes. ...And that turned into hatred and curses.
lines.133: But that just now...!! It wasn't something that could be summed up in words like that...!
lines.138: ...I... could only leave behind... something like that...
lines.143: ...I take it back. You really don't need memories of the past.
lines.146: If it hurts that much, just throw them away. You're "Rooma", right? You don't need to carry the Dragon of Darkness's memories.
lines.161: Couette doesn't really understand. But, but--!!
lines.171: Big sis Challua's place is so warm, and the food is yummy, and it's super fun!
lines.174: Eric, you saw the flower fields too, right? We're gonna live there, so you're absolutely, positively gonna go all fwaaaah~!
lines.178: Hey, don't go saying random stuff. There are monsters over there too. What if Eric gets hurt?
lines.186: Eric's... that boy's mother died in the war with the fiends. He lives with Marly now.
lines.189: We were enemies. But not anymore.
lines.196: ...Were it not for who you once were, we would not exist today.
lines.199: As the representative of the fiends, allow me to thank you. --Truly, thank you.
lines.208: Armadeus's feelings might have gotten twisted along the way.
lines.210: But even so, that wish is what connected us. ...That's what I think, anyway.
lines.220: ......A dragon, crying. You're a weird one.
lines.225: ...What I can do, what I want to do, I still don't know.
lines.228: But I want to live on together with the people and the feelings you left behind.

3.title: Parting in Calamity
3.summary: While working with Rustamov to help people attacked by the Purgers, Armadeus is reunited with Capella, who was like a parent to him. Refusing the hand Capella offers, Armadeus bids farewell to his friend and parent, and takes flight as Rooma to carry on everyone's feelings.

lines.7: Dammit, what are these things!! What the hell are theeeey!!
lines.26: Hmph! They gave me some trouble at first, but they're just puppets! They're no match for us!
lines.30: Just how many of them are there... This is endless...!
lines.33: Dealing with each one is a pain. Wouldn't it be better to ignore them all and go to Couette?
lines.38: I can't abandon the people right in front of me.
lines.41: There it is. You sure go all out for humans you don't even know.
lines.54: So the time of the Purge has come. Infuriating, but this world is finished...
lines.55: But the "Sword" has crossed into the realm of the stars...
lines.63: It really is you, Capella... Even looking completely different... I can tell.
lines.66: ...I see. And you're not Arma after all. A shame.
lines.73: It's okay, Rustamov. I knew already...
lines.76: My apologies. With Maiko Warren's body and brain, perhaps I might have felt something?
lines.79: ...What is this guy? His insides are a total mess. Are they mixed together...?
lines.81: You sure have a lot of weird friends.
lines.85: ...No. Capella is... like a parent to me.
lines.93: So? What is it you want? Depending on what it is, I might oblige. What do you seek from me?
lines.99: ......I don't know. When I thought it might be you, Capella, I just...
lines.110: ......Me-- No, so you do "help humans" after all.
lines.112: I take back what I said earlier. Arma. Won't you come with me?
lines.114: You want to help humans, don't you?
lines.117: ...That's right. I want to protect humans.
lines.120: But it's not because I'm Armadeus.
lines.124: I want to protect the wishes he connected for me, as Rooma.
lines.128: ...So, I'm sorry. I won't go with you, Capella.
lines.131: Ah, I see. I understand now, Capella.
lines.133: I came to say goodbye to you.
lines.155: Seriously, how many of these things keep popping up...!
lines.159: ...What do we do? Meet up with Sis Rams and the others?
lines.163: ...No. I can't abandon the people here.
lines.168: Figured you'd say that. Oh, fine. Then the Holy Dragon King Rustamov himself will keep you company...!
lines.176: Besides, being ordered around is a pain. Let's go wild on our own over here!
lines.183: I'll fly through this sky as myself.

1261089/1.19:
An ancient dragon who defied his fate and fell
to a curse. For ages he was twisted by rage
and hatred. But he met a girl, walked within
dreams-- and the dragon took flight into a new life.

5000139/3.19:
Though only in small fragments, Curse Crystals in which Armadeus engraved his memories remained in the fiends' realm as well, and with the fiends' help, they were passed on to the reborn Rooma.

Those memories torment Rooma, but he will likely never let them go.

5000468/3.19:
Interfering with the Dracostream generally requires large-scale spells or dedicated facilities. Gram, in fact, had to build a giant labyrinth to interfere with it.
However, if there is some bond between the caster and the Dracostream or something within it, even a small-scale spell can interfere.
